summary: ANOLA GEO AS (org. no. 926 998 579) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2021-05-07. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 71.122 (Geologiske undersøkelser). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 3.2 m and net income was NOK 1.6 m. Board chair: David Selvåg Larsen. Also: LEI 636700W5311BGLWPAC47.
